metadata.name: Runway Nine
metadata.author: Tile Trigger
metadata.description: An airport at dusk. Flight 9, a wide-body jet, stands at gate 9 on the jet bridge: walk its cockpit, galleys, first class, two aisles of economy and the lavatories, drop through the hatches into the cargo hold, and climb out of the over-wing exits onto the wings. The cabin doors open twelve seconds in; the cockpit's emergency release opens the right-hand side. Around it: the two-storey terminal (baggage make-up, reclaim, check-in, the glass-fronted gate lounge, shops and security), fuel trucks that blow up, baggage carts and tugs, the control tower with a sniper's cab, the maintenance hangar with a business jet, the taxiway and the lit runway. Hostage Rescue: the Hijackers hold four passengers aboard and the Response team brings them out to the lounge or the hangar. Bomb: the cockpit and the forward hold. Capture the Flag: the reclaim hall against the cabin.

do.text: Runway Nine. Flight 9's doors are armed: they open in 12 s.
Cabin doors open: L1, L2, L3 and the catering door.
Emergency release: the right-hand doors are open!
The right-hand doors are locked again.
Gate 9: the jet bridge door is locked for 15 s.
